name: [SUMMER] Randomizer: Redux
desc:
Game Version: Beta 2.5

This game is an official remake of the OG Randomizer, from the ground up!
It is still under HEAVY development, so everything is subject to change, and everything you see is incomplete! 

To use the admin panel in private servers, type '/admin' in chat.
For a list of commands, just type 'cmds' into the admin panel, premium users get extra commands!

Controls:
M - Menu (only when spawn protection is active, or you died)
C / CTRL / Button B / Circle - Crouch/Slide (while sprinting)
Shift / Left Stick - Sprint
P - Mouse Lock/Unlock
Left Alt - Camera Lock (Third Person)
